name: lw_33655
statement: {a : ℕ → ℕ} (h : a 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ n, a (n + 1) = a n + Int.floor (Real.sqrt (a n))) : ∀ n, (∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ k + k - 2) ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, a n = k ^ 2
closed: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℕ} (h : a 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ n, a (n + 1) = a n + Int.floor (Real.sqrt (a n))), ∀ n, (∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ k + k - 2) ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, a n = k ^ 2
informal: Let $(a_n)$ be integer sequence defined by : \n $a_1=1,a_{n+1}=a_n+\left \lfloor \sqrt{a_n} \right \rfloor$ \nProve that $a_n$ is perfect square if only if $n=2^k+k-2$ , where $k$ is natural number.
